sanctuary_sites: CNS (prophylaxis considered in high CNS-IPI, testicular, breast, kidney/adrenal, high-grade, or other extranodal high-risk sites)
heme_involvement_pattern.staging_system: Lugano modification of Ann Arbor. IPI / R-IPI / NCCN-IPI prognostic scores. CNS-IPI for CNS relapse risk.

biomarkers.name: Cell-of-origin (COO): Hans algorithm (CD10, BCL6, MUM1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: GCB (CD10+ OR CD10-/BCL6+/MUM1-) vs ABC/non-GCB (CD10-/BCL6+/MUM1+ OR CD10-/BCL6-). GCB has better prognosis with R-CHOP. Gene expression profiling (eg, Lymph2Cx, NanoString) is more accurate than IHC surrogates

biomarkers.name: CD20
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rituximab-containing immunochemotherapy (R-CHOP standard first-line; pola-R-CHP also CD20-directed via rituximab backbone). Loss at relapse can occur — CD20-negative relapse limits rituximab retreatment

biomarkers.name: CD19, CD22, CD79b
biomarkers.prevalence: Common B-cell antigens; expression should be confirmed on tumor cells
biomarkers.clinical_use: CD19: CAR-T targets (axi-cel, liso-cel, tisa-cel) approved for R/R LBCL/DLBCL in appropriate settings; loncastuximab tesirine (anti-CD19 ADC). CD22: no standard approved DLBCL-directed agent. CD79b: polatuzumab vedotin (ADC; pola-R-CHP first-line option in IPI 2-5)

biomarkers.name: MYC, BCL2, BCL6 rearrangements (FISH)
biomarkers.prevalence: MYC ~5-15%; BCL2 ~20-30% (more common in GCB); BCL6 ~20-30%
biomarkers.clinical_use: MYC rearrangement alone: adverse but not reclassified. Concurrent MYC + BCL2 rearrangements define high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements; MYC + BCL6 cases may be biologically adverse but are not included in that entity in current WHO/ICC classifications

biomarkers.name: MYC and BCL2 protein overexpression ('double expressor')
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse; distinct from double-hit (which is rearrangement-based)

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.clinical_use: Expression is seen in a subset of DLBCL, but brentuximab vedotin does not have an established standard role in routine DLBCL management

biomarkers.name: EBV (EBER ISH)
biomarkers.prevalence: Minor subset; uncommon in immunocompetent patients and more frequent in older or immunosuppressed patients
biomarkers.clinical_use: EBV-positive DLBCL is recognized as a distinct entity in current classifications and is generally associated with worse prognosis

biomarkers.name: CNS-IPI
biomarkers.clinical_use: Age, LDH, ECOG, stage, extranodal sites, kidney/adrenal involvement — predicts CNS relapse risk. High CNS-IPI plus selected sites such as testis, breast, or kidney/adrenal may prompt consideration of CNS prophylaxis, although benefit remains uncertain

biomarkers.name: Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Emerging MRD/disease-monitoring tool in DLBCL; end-of-treatment ctDNA positivity is associated with relapse risk, but routine standard-of-care use remains limited

biomarkers.name: IPI / R-IPI / NCCN-IPI
biomarkers.clinical_use: Foundation of DLBCL prognostication. NCCN-IPI adds age tiers and refined LDH categorisation

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diffuse infiltrate of large B lymphocytes with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and moderate cytoplasm effacing normal architecture
variants: centroblastic (large, non-cleaved, multiple peripheral nucleoli — most common)
T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma (variant pattern/related entity)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not morphologically graded; molecular subtyping (COO, LymphGen) drives risk

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: GCB-derived — reflects germinal centre B-cell biology (BCL6, often EZH2 pathway activity); more responsive to R-CHOP than ABC/non-GCB subtype
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture; extranodal involvement common

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Germinal centre B cells (centroblasts) — recapitulates germinal centre B-cell biology at genomic and transcriptomic level
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Germinal centre B-cell differentiation with active AID/somatic hypermutation programme; retains B-cell markers (CD19, CD20, CD22, CD79b); expresses germinal centre programme markers (BCL6, CD10, HGAL)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: GCB DLBCL recapitulates germinal centre B-cell biology — BCL6 (master germinal centre transcription factor), frequent EZH2 alterations/pathway activation, and recurrent BCL2 rearrangements including t(14;18) help maintain the programme and impair apoptosis during germinal centre selection
